submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective detector for the token that resolves the currently open unit: a subword finishing a rare word (amoxic->illin, Photos->ynthesis), a symbol or collocate completing a fixed frame (as->np, golden->brown), or the predicate, complement, or head noun a clause was waiting for (Lima->are, cat->sat, defendant->pleaded, submit->report), plus a unigram bias for sentence-initial discourse tokens (Please, I, Hello). Lexically incongruous fillers (table for brown/pleaded) and structural function words (the, and, ., on) stay near zero. The subword/symbol completions fire via the standard g+u+ SwiGLU regime while the clause-level resolvers fire via the double-negative g-u- regime, i.e. two related implementations of one resolution job.
